perks.name: Network Admin
perks.description:
Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.
perks.exact:
While an ally is within 15? meters:
+? Handling and +? Reload Speed.

+? Health Stat while an allied Network Admin is within 15m.

perks.name: Network Upload
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.
perks.exact:
On Weapon Kill:
?% Melee Energy for the user and their allies within ? meters.

item.name: Void Targeting
item.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Void weapons.
item.exact:
To Mod-Element Matching Weapons, after 1 second of readying the weapon:

+5 | +8 | +10 Aim Assist
0.9x | 0.85x | 0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
 0.85x | 0.75x | 0.7x ADS Duration Multiplier

item.name: Harmonic Siphon
item.description: Rapid Arc weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
Upon scoring 2 Mod-Element Matching Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Orb of Power.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orbs of Power before additional kills count.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.
